title: Privacy Policy
body: This policy explains what personal information HSG Attorneys (“we”, “us”) collects through this website, why, and what we do with it. It covers this website only. Information you give us in the course of a legal matter is handled under our engagement terms and our professional duties of confidentiality.

• When you send an enquiry through the contact form: your name, email address, phone number (if you give it), the type of matter, your message, and a record that you gave consent and when. We also record the internet (IP) address the enquiry was sent from.
  • To block spam: the form has a hidden field that people do not see. If it is filled in, we keep the IP address, browser type, and the name and email entered, so that a genuine enquiry caught by mistake can be found. To stop repeated automated submissions, the server keeps a record derived from your IP address (not the address itself).
  • Server logs: like most websites, our hosting provider’s web server records the IP address, browser type, date and time, and pages requested for each visit. We use these only to keep the site running and secure.
This website does not set cookies of its own and does not use analytics or advertising trackers. The property cost calculators work in your browser; the figures you enter are not sent to us.

Some pages show content from other providers. Videos (YouTube) and maps (Google Maps) load only when you click to play or open them. LinkedIn posts on the website load from LinkedIn as you scroll to them. When any of these load, your browser connects to that provider, which receives your IP address and may set its own cookies under its own privacy policy.

We use the information in an enquiry to respond to you and, if you instruct us, to take on and run your matter. We do not sell your information and we do not use it for marketing unless you have agreed to that separately.

Enquiries are delivered to the firm’s email and are seen by the people at the firm who deal with them. Our website hosting and email providers store the information on our behalf; their servers may be located outside South Africa. We will disclose personal information to anyone else only where the law requires or permits it.
We keep enquiry records only for as long as we need them to deal with the enquiry, or for longer where the law or our professional record-keeping obligations require it.

The website is served over an encrypted (HTTPS) connection, and the stored enquiry records cannot be reached from the web. No system is completely secure, so please do not send highly sensitive documents through the contact form; we will arrange a suitable way to receive them.

You may ask us what personal information we hold about you, and ask us to correct or delete it, or object to our using it. Write to the firm’s Information Officer at legal@hsginc.co.za or at the address below. If you are not satisfied with our response, you may complain to the Information Regulator.
We will update this policy if what the website collects changes. The date at the top of this page shows when it was last updated.
